From: MARK TRAMO

Subject: To Marvin re: Connecting
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2017 22:53:08 +0000

Greetings, Marvin Great talking with you this morning - thank you for your kind words about my talk and for inviting me to the
studio today! Sony I wasn't available today. Kudos on your success with Nylon! Loved the Bowie photo you
showed me - we are kindred spirits there. And thank you for offering to introduce me to Dhani Harrison after my
talk last week - hard to express or quantify how much his dad and bandmates have inspired me and my career since 1st grade!
I'm usually at UCLA on Wednesdays and some Sats and Suns working on my book. Perhaps you might consider
visiting my home practice studio in Moorpark one weekend sometime soon?
My permanent email address is
Cell number is
Thanks for asking to
hear a recording - will follow-up this email with another that links to a song on my Google drive I wrote and
recorded with Dionne Anylah. Would greatly appreciate your comments and criticisms - heartfelt from the early
days of the AIDS wars in Manhattan, written after doing a spinal tap that led me to diagnose him with CNS
Lymphoma - he died a few days later.
Happy Thanksgiving!
Mark
